name: Bernoulli
caution: One trial, with success coded as 1. The endpoint probabilities give constant variables.

name: Binomial
caution: Counts successes in \(n\) independent trials with one fixed success probability. At \(p=0\) or \(p=1\), use the corresponding constant law. Small variance alone does not justify a Poisson approximation.

name: Poisson
caution: The parameter is the mean count over the stated observation interval. A Poisson approximation to a binomial needs a rare-success regime with small \(p\), not just low variance.

name: Geometric, trials convention
caution: Includes the first successful trial. A failures-only convention subtracts 1 and has mean \((1-p)/p\). At \(p=1\), the trial count is 1.

name: Negative binomial, trials convention
caution: Counts all trials through the \(r\)th success. Trials must be independent with one fixed success probability. At \(p=1\), the boundary law is \(T_r=r\).

name: Negative binomial, failures convention
caution: Counts failures before success \(r\). Since \(F_r=T_r-r\), its mean differs from the trials convention by \(r\). At \(p=1\), it is zero.

name: Hypergeometric
caution: A simple random sample of size \(n\) is drawn without replacement from \(N\) items with \(m\) marked. The variance includes the finite-population factor.

name: Uniform
caution: Equal-length intervals have equal probability. Individual endpoint values of the density do not affect the law, and endpoints have probability zero.

name: Normal
caution: The second parameter in \(N(\mu,\sigma^2)\) is variance. Standardize with \((X-\mu)/\sigma\). The degenerate case \(\sigma=0\) has no ordinary density.

name: Exponential
formula: PDF: \(f_X(x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}\) for \(x>0\), zero elsewhere.
caution: Uses the rate parameterization. Scale equals \(1/\lambda\). The memoryless tail identity is a property of this law, not of all waiting times.

name: Gamma
caution: Shape need not be an integer. Independent gamma shapes add under a common rate. If a reference uses scale \(\theta\), substitute \(\lambda=1/\theta\).

name: Lognormal
caution: The parameters describe the normal logarithm. The median is \(e^\mu\), which differs from the mean. The moments follow from the normal MGF in L03 by \(E[X^k]=E[e^{k\log X}]\).

name: Beta
caution: Shapes below 1 can give unbounded endpoint densities but no endpoint atoms. The uniform law is \(\operatorname{Beta}(1,1)\).

name: Atom-plus-density mixture
support: One atom at \(a\), together with the support of the continuous branch.
parameters: \(0<w<1\), atom \(a\in\mathbb R\); continuous branch has CDF \(G\), density \(g\), finite mean \(\mu\), finite variance \(v\).
formula: CDF: \(F_X(x)=w\mathbf1_{\{x\ge a\}}+(1-w)G(x)\). Atom mass \(w\), density contribution \((1-w)g(x)\).
caution: The derivative of the CDF away from its atom integrates to \(1-w\), not 1. Include the atom separately in probabilities and moments.
